text: So sorry to bother you this late, I'm a foster carer and I've had Tyler (18 months) with me for a few weeks so I dont know his normal as well as I'd like. He's had a temp today, 38.1 when I checked just now. About 20 mins ago he had a fit, his whole body went stiff then his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes rolled up. Its never happend before, not that I know of and its not in any of his notes. Also I just realised his nappy has been dry since this morning, so thats over 12 hours with no wee at all. I'm really sorry if I'm overreacting but I didnt know who else to ask
